modules.description: Creates a virtual LAN room so games on different devices can find each other. Only that room's network is routed, not your internet connection.
Tuning's frame generation: Fixed, Dynamic, and Power Saver. It fills the refreshes the game leaves empty, up to the screen's refresh rate.
Lossless Scaling frame generation. It draws extra frames from the game image. Use it instead of Tuning FG or WFG.
WFG frame generation. It draws extra frames from the game image. Use it instead of Tuning FG or LSFG.
Moves the pointer to the exact spot you touch, for strategy games without touch controls. One finger moves it; a second finger and a pinch handle the other button and the scroll wheel.
Steam, GOG, and itch.io. Sign in, download games, and launch them from the library.
Small file patches so specific Steam games can run online here. Squad Blast is included. Stores must be installed.
